d:
Delhi-NCR has long attracted professionals looking for better jobs and bigger opportunities. But as air pollution, persistent dust and deteriorating living conditions take a toll on everyday life, some are choosing to leave the city in search of cleaner air.
From a former cricketer who moved to Pune to a father who relocated his family to Siliguri, we look at why professionals are reconsidering life in Delhi-NCR. But can everyone afford to move away? And what happens to those who have no choice but to stay?
